rci1_using_msad.detail: Healthy controls aggregated from three independent cohorts; EMBARC cohort recruited at four study sites.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We built a normative model with resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) connectivity data from healthy controls of three independent cohorts."; "Subjects were recruited at four study sites (University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center, Massachusetts General Hospital, Columbia University and University of Michigan)"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort consists of EMBARC, Depression-EEG, and LEMON cohorts (not in the EPD list).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We built a normative model with resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) connectivity data from healthy controls of three independent cohorts."; "The first cohort consists of 39 healthy subjects from the Establishing Moderators and Biosignatures of Antidepressant Response for Clinical Care (EMBARC) study"; "The second cohort consists of 75 healthy subjects from the Depression-EEG cohort"; "The third cohort consists of 153 young healthy subjects ... from the Leipzig Study for Mind-Body-Emotion Interactions (LEMON) cohort"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase healthy controls pooled from three cohorts (8 EMBARC, 75 Depression-EEG, 71 LEMON) with age 18-25.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we developed healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18 -25), which consist of 8 subjects from the EMBARC cohort, 75 subjects from the depression-EEG cohort, and 71 subjects from the LEMON cohort."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; male counts summed across cohorts (4+35+41=80); female_n estimated from total N (154) minus male_n.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age range 18-25 for healthy norms. Weighted mean computed from cohort means (21.6, 19.0, 22.5) and Ns (8, 75, 71); LEMON SD not reported so pooled SD not computed.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "we developed healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18 -25)"; "Age, yr 21.6 (2.8) 19.0 (1.2) 22.5 (NA)"
